title: Clean tools, realistic days and prices that pay
course_title: Hair Care & Simple Styling: Salon Service Practice

say: Clean tools, realistic days, and prices that pay.
This is the video for module 4 of Hair Care and Simple Styling.
A skilled stylist can still lose clients. Combs, clips and towels move from head to head, and without a routine they carry lice, fungal infections and bacteria.

say: And a price copied from the salon down the road may not cover your own hair, products, fuel and time. This module fixes all three.

say: Always clean first. Soap and water remove hair and gel. Disinfectant poured over a dirty comb does very little.

panel.heading: Mixing 2 litres of 0.1% bleach
items: Clean with soap and water first
5% bleach: 40 ml for 2,000 ml in total
Water: 2,000 minus 40 = 1,960 ml
Gloves on, window open, label and date it

say: For example, Zainab in Jos wants 2 litres of 0.1% bleach solution. The rule is 0.1 times the total millilitres, divided by the percentage on the label. With 5% bleach, that is 40 ml of bleach.

panel.heading: Mixing 2 litres of 0.1% bleach
items: Clean with soap and water first
5% bleach: 40 ml for 2,000 ml in total
Water: 2,000 minus 40 = 1,960 ml
Gloves on, window open, label and date it

say: The rest is water: 1,960 ml. That is 1 part bleach to 49 parts water. If your label shows a different strength, recalculate.

panel.heading: Mixing 2 litres of 0.1% bleach
items: Clean with soap and water first
5% bleach: 40 ml for 2,000 ml in total
Water: 2,000 minus 40 = 1,960 ml
Gloves on, window open, label and date it

say: Mix it with rubber gloves on, in a ventilated place, away from children and food. Label it do not drink, with the date, and make it fresh each working day.
Never mix bleach with ammonia or other cleaners, because they can release dangerous gases.

say: After every single client, sweep the hair into a covered bin, and put used combs and clips straight into a used container. Never back on the tray.

panel.heading: The 15-minute reset
items: Sweep hair into a covered bin
Used combs and clips into the used box
Wash, scrub, soak plastic tools, rinse, dry
Wipe chair, tray and mirror
Fresh towel and cape for the next client
Wash hands for 40 to 60 seconds

say: Wash them in soapy water, scrub between the teeth, soak plastic tools in the bleach solution, then rinse and dry. Bleach damages metal, so wash metal tools with soap instead.

panel.heading: The 15-minute reset

Wash hands for 40 to 60 seconds

say: Wipe the chair, tray and mirror. One towel per client, so take a fresh towel and cape.

say: Then wash your hands for 40 to 60 seconds, and set out clean tools.

say: Late days come from guessing. For your next 10 services, write the start and end time of every stage, then work out your averages.

panel.heading: Book the whole service, not the braids
items: Log every stage for 10 services
Consultation, wash, stretch, braiding, finish
Braids x your minutes per braid
Add the 15-minute reset before the next booking

say: A service is consultation, prep, braiding and finishing.

panel.heading: Book the whole service, not the braids
items: Log every stage for 10 services

Add the 15-minute reset before the next booking

say: For braiding, multiply the number of braids by your minutes per braid. For example, 76 braids at 6 minutes is 456 minutes.

say: Then add the reset before you book the next client. For example, Blessing in Owerri plans three Saturday bookings with resets and a 30-minute lunch, and finishes at 3 p.m. as she planned.

say: For example, Ifeoma in Asaba prices 8 feed-in cornrows with extensions. She builds the price from her own costs first.
Hair, gel, wash materials, gloves and neck strip come to about 4,930 naira.
Her log shows 3.5 hours. At her target of 1,500 naira an hour, that is 5,250 naira.
Monthly overheads of about 30,000 naira over about 60 services give 500 naira per service.
Total cost: 10,680 naira. She adds a 20% profit margin and rounds to 13,000 naira. Only then does she compare with nearby salons.
Ask for a deposit when you buy hair for a client. About 30% of 13,000 naira is 3,900, so Ifeoma asks for 4,000 naira, which covers the hair.

cards.d: About 30% when you buy hair. On a 13,000 naira style, she asks for 4,000 naira.
Open your own bank app and see the money in your balance. A screenshot or SMS is not proof.
If hair prices rise or a style takes longer, update the menu and tell regular clients first.

say: Fake transfer alerts and edited screenshots are a common trick. Before she leaves, open your own bank app and confirm the money is in your balance.

cards.d: About 30% when you buy hair. On a 13,000 naira style, she asks for 4,000 naira.

say: Review your prices every three months, and tell regular clients before a change. Fair changes are accepted. Surprise charges are not.

say: To remember. Clean first, then disinfect, and never mix bleach with other cleaners. Measure your times and book the reset. Build prices from your costs, then add profit. And confirm every payment in your own app.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Clean with soap first, then disinfect
Never mix bleach with other cleaners
Time every stage; book the reset too
Price = materials + time + overhead + profit
Confirm every transfer in your own app
